transcript: In a democratic society, the press has been called the fourth estate Alongside the legislative, the executive, and the judicial It is one of the pillars that supports society Journalists carry the role of revealing wrongdoing In government and business And passing that on to the citizens Invest reporting has often been the trigger That has changed society In 1972, during the Watergate scandal Two young reporters helped expose abuses of power It led to the American president's resignation That was an example of how the press can hold Even the highest authority is accountable In our time, however, the reliability of information Has become a great challenge Information sent out without checking the source Deliberate disinformation These can twist the judgment of society Under dictatorships in various countries Censorship is common And it is not rare for journalists to be imprisoned Press freedom is not taken for granted in every country As receivers of information We must develop the ability to judge What is a reliable source To protect the freedom of the press Is in the end To protect our own freedom Bye.

segments.text: In a democratic society, the press has been called the fourth estate
Alongside the legislative, the executive, and the judicial
It is one of the pillars that supports society
Journalists carry the role of revealing wrongdoing
In government and business
And passing that on to the citizens
Invest reporting has often been the trigger
That has changed society
In 1972, during the Watergate scandal
Two young reporters helped expose abuses of power
It led to the American president's resignation
That was an example of how the press can hold
Even the highest authority is accountable
In our time, however, the reliability of information
Has become a great challenge
Information sent out without checking the source
Deliberate disinformation
These can twist the judgment of society
Under dictatorships in various countries
Censorship is common
And it is not rare for journalists to be imprisoned
Press freedom is not taken for granted in every country
As receivers of information
We must develop the ability to judge
What is a reliable source
To protect the freedom of the press
Is in the end
To protect our own freedom
Bye.
